what_it_does: Slim-Llama is a specialized computer chip designed to run very large AI language models (with a billion parameters—think a billion dials to tune) using binary or ternary quantization, which means storing the model's numbers as only 1 or 2 bits instead of the usual 16-32 bits. The core challenge is that language models need to read their learned weights from main memory billions of times, which burns enormous energy in most designs. Slim-Llama reduces the energy cost per parameter from the usual 26-222 picojoules down to 9 picojoules (about 3-25 times more efficient), allowing the entire chip to run at under 5 milliwatts—comparable to a hearing aid.
